requirements.description: Daily stock returns/prices/volume/shares for MAX, BETA (252-day), IVOL, ILLIQ, REV, MOM, CE, turnover, price>=5 filter (motivated by rules var_max, var_beta_252d, var_illiq, var_ivol, universe_price_above_5, avail_min_15_daily_observations)
Monthly returns and month-end ME for VW portfolio returns and one-month-ahead excess returns (rule sort_excess_returns_rf, var_size)

Point-in-time share codes / exchange codes / SIC for the universe filters (shrcd 10/11, NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ, SIC 4900-4949 and 6000-6999 exclusions; rules universe_exchanges_sharecodes, universe_sic_exclusions)
Delisting returns for the delisting-return convention (paper silent on delisting; Shumway 1997 substitution applied per default convention — rule delisting_paper_silent)
CRSP-Compustat merge link for Compustat-based variables (BM, ROE, I/A, MIS anomalies, CE; rules var_bm, var_roe, var_ia, var_mis)

Annual fundamentals for book equity (SEQ+TXDB+ITCB-pref), BM, accruals, NOA, asset growth, INV/AT, gross profitability, O-score, I/A (rules var_book_equity, var_bm, var_accruals, var_noa, var_ag_syy, var_inv_at, var_gp, var_oscore, var_ia)
Quarterly fundamentals for ROE (ibq / one-quarter-lagged book equity) and CHS (2008) distress inputs (rules var_roe, var_distress)
Fama-French monthly factors for CAPM/FF3/FFC4/FF5/FF6 model alphas (rules factor_models_risk, factor_sources); Mkt-RF/SMB/HML/RF/MOM from four_factor_monthly, RMW/CMA from five_factor_monthly
Pastor-Stambaugh (2003) traded liquidity factor (LIQ_V, 10-1 portfolio return) for FFCPS/FF6PS models (rules factor_models_risk, factor_ff6ps_composition)
Stambaugh-Yuan (2017) M4 mispricing factors (MKTRF, SMB, MGMT, PERF, RF) for SY alphas (rule factor_models_mispricing)
Daniel-Hirshleifer-Sun (2020) behavioral factors (FIN, PEAD) for DHS alphas in Tables 1 and 6 (rules factor_models_mispricing, avail_dhs_1972_2022)

Thomson Reuters 13F holdings for INST and delta-INST (rules var_inst, var_dinst, sort_inst_tiers); coverage confirmed 1980-03-31 to 2023-06-30, spanning the paper's April 1980-December 2022 INST sample
Baker-Wurgler (2006) investor sentiment index for the sentiment-state conditioning in Table A7 (rules sort_sentiment_issuance_states, sort_sentiment_regime_a1)

blocking_issues.reason: RMW and CMA live in ff.five_factor_monthly (1963-07 onward), not in ff.four_factor_monthly; two tables must be joined to assemble FF6.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Join ff.four_factor_monthly (mkt_rf, smb, hml, rf, mom) with ff.five_factor_monthly (rmw, cma) on dt to assemble FF6 and FF6PS.

blocking_issues.reason: Pastor-Stambaugh LIQ factor is not in ClickHouse; user-provided file inputs/liq_data_1962_2024.txt contains the traded LIQ_V factor with first valid month 1968-01 (paper sample starts Jan 1968 - aligned) through Dec 2024.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Load the traded LIQ_V column from inputs/liq_data_1962_2024.txt (parse Month YYYYMM, drop -99 sentinel values) and append it to the FF6 factor set for FFCPS/FF6PS; record the file provenance in assumptions.md.

blocking_issues.reason: SY M4 factors are not in ClickHouse; user-provided inputs/M4.csv (MKTRF, SMB, MGMT, PERF, RF) covers 1963-01 through 2016-12 only, versus the paper's Jan 1968-Dec 2022 SY estimation window.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Load inputs/M4.csv and estimate SY alphas on the Jan 1968-Dec 2016 subperiod; document the 2017-2022 coverage gap with the [THIRD-PARTY-DATASET] marker in assumptions.md.

blocking_issues.reason: FIN and PEAD factors are neither in ClickHouse nor among the provided files (they are published on Lin Sun's website).
blocking_issues.recommendation: Evaluate the DHS columns of Tables 1 and 6 as SKIP (no factor data); obtain FIN/PEAD from Lin Sun's website to close the gap.

blocking_issues.reason: Baker-Wurgler (2006) sentiment index is neither in ClickHouse nor among the provided files.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Table A7 sentiment columns are excluded from the committed metrics of T9 (see T9 notes in tables_to_replicate.json); only the aggregate-issuance columns are replicated.
